package: @astryxdesign/core

# LayoutFooter

Bottom bar for action bars, pagination, and status bars.

## Import

```tsx
import { LayoutFooter } from '@astryxdesign/core/Layout';
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Footer content. |
| `hasDivider` | `boolean` | `false` | Border at top edge. When unset, the parent Layout's defaultHasDividers decides. |
| `height` | `SizeValue` | - | Footer height. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is. |
| `label` | `string` | - | Accessible label for the landmark element. |
| `padding` | `0 \| 0.5 \| 1 \| 1.5 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 8 \| 10` | - | Internal padding on every edge, using the spacing scale. Replaces the inset from the layout; 0 is full bleed. |
| `role` | `AriaRole` | - | ARIA landmark role. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | - | Ref forwarded to the footer element. |
